02 Scaling method

Find what sells.
Build on it.

Start with a shop that can convert, then use creator and product performance to decide what gets more attention and budget.

  1. 01

    Get the shop ready

    Audit the catalog, fix setup and compliance gaps, and improve the listings, offers, and bundles for priority products.

  2. 02

    Recruit creators who fit the product

    Set up affiliate collaborations, send samples, and brief creators on demos and content angles they can make their own.

  3. 03

    Test content, LIVE, and paid media

    Track which creators, videos, and products generate orders. Reuse the hooks that work and test proven assets with GMV Max.

  4. 04

    Scale what the shop can support

    Expand winning products and partnerships while watching inventory, fulfillment, margins, and account health.

Hi, I’m Muhammad Umar Yaseen.

I’ve been managing TikTok Shops since 2023, when the platform was still in its early days. Since then, I’ve helped scale multiple brands, including the beauty and personal care shops featured here.
